skips.name: Cfenv.MathErrhandlingPerPlatform

skips.name: Coroutines.GeneratorAvailabilityPerLibrary
skips.reason: the page only states availability for GCC 15 libstdc++ and Clang 22 libc++

skips.name: ErroneousBehaviour.Gcc16ReadsZero
skips.reason: needs a compiler that implements erroneous behaviour (GCC 16)

skips.name: Freestanding.FfreestandingFlag
skips.reason: needs a build with -ffreestanding; the suite builds hosted only (checked by hand: g++-15 and clang++ 22 -ffreestanding give __STDC_HOSTED__ 0)

skips.name: ImportStd.HeaderUnits
skips.reason: header units (import <vector>;): CMake doesn't support them (cmake-cxxmodules(7), Limitations); checked by tools/check_snippets.py instead

skips.name: ImportStd.MacrosNeedTheHeader
skips.reason: CMake 3.31.12: import std is experimental before 4.5, and the top-level CMakeLists.txt sets the gate only for 4.3 and 4.4 (the versions tested)

skips.name: ImportStd.StdCompatHasGlobalCNames
skips.reason: CMake 3.31.12: import std is experimental before 4.5, and the top-level CMakeLists.txt sets the gate only for 4.3 and 4.4 (the versions tested)

skips.name: Mdspan.LibrarySupport
skips.reason: toolchain not covered by the page's support note

skips.name: Modules.PrivateModuleFragment
skips.reason: GCC 14.2.0: private module fragment not implemented (sorry, unimplemented)

skips.name: Mutexes.CallOnceRetriesAfterThrow
skips.reason: libstdc++ off Linux: call_once with a throwing callable is broken (GCC PR 66146)

skips.name: NullTerminatedByteStrings.CharSignedness
skips.reason: page only states char signedness for arm64 macOS and arm64 Linux

skips.name: NullTerminatedMultibyteStrings.CLocaleRejectsMultibyte

skips.name: NullTerminatedMultibyteStrings.MbCurMaxInUtf8
skips.reason: MB_CUR_MAX is implementation-defined; page states macOS and glibc only

skips.name: NullTerminatedMultibyteStrings.Mbrtoc8
skips.reason: FreeBSD's <uchar.h> (14.5, 15.1) declares no mbrtoc8/c8rtomb (C23), so <cuchar> has no std::mbrtoc8 with GCC or Clang/libc++

skips.name: NullTerminatedWideStrings.NarrowUnrepresentable
skips.reason: what the C locale does with non-ASCII wide chars is libc-specific

skips.name: NullTerminatedWideStrings.PrintfLsInCLocale
skips.reason: page states this for glibc and macOS only

skips.name: NullTerminatedWideStrings.WcharMax
skips.reason: page only states WCHAR_MAX for arm64 macOS and arm64 Linux

skips.name: ObjectModel.MainFunction
skips.reason: gtest_main owns main(), so its implicit return and argv can't be observed here

skips.name: Print.FeatureMacroPerToolchain
skips.reason: value recorded only for GCC 15/16 and libc++ 22

skips.name: SafeReclamation.CompilerSupportTable
skips.reason: table covers only GCC 15/16 and libc++ 22

skips.reason: <stdckdint.h> here is GCC's C header (ckd_add uses _Bool), not usable from C++; libstdc++'s C++26 <stdckdint.h> (P3370R1) arrived in GCC 15

skips.name: Saturation.ToolchainSupport
